nodes.summary: For a rational number $x$ and natural numbers $k$ and $n$, $\Delta^k x^n$ denotes the value at $x$ of the $k$-th iterate of the forward difference operator applied to the function $y \mapsto y^n$ on $\mathbb{Q}$, where the forward difference of $f \colon \mathbb{Q} \to \mathbb{Q}$ is the function $y \mapsto f(y + 1) - f(y)$.
nodes.title: Iterated forward differences of a power on $\mathbb{Q}$

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the Genocchi number $G_n$, defined by $\frac{2x}{e^x + 1} = \sum_{m \ge 0} G_m \frac{x^m}{m!}$, satisfies $G_n = 2(1 - 2^n) B_n$, where $B_n$ is the $n$-th Bernoulli number with the convention $B_1 = -\tfrac{1}{2}$.
nodes.title: Genocchi numbers in terms of Bernoulli numbers

nodes.summary: Let $n$ and $r$ be positive integers with $n \ge r + 1$, let $G_n$ be the $n$-th Genocchi number and let $S(a, b)$ denote the Stirling numbers of the second kind. For $k \ge 1$ write $c_k = \sum_{j=0}^{r} (-1)^{k+j+r} \frac{(k+j-1)!}{2^{k+j-1}} S(r, j)$. Then $G_n = (-1)^n \, n \sum_{k=1}^{n-r} c_k \, S(n-r, k)$.
nodes.title: Explicit formula for Genocchi numbers via Stirling numbers

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the Genocchi number $G_n$ equals $n!$ times the coefficient of $x^n$ in the Genocchi power series $\frac{2x}{e^x + 1} \in \mathbb{Q}[[x]]$.
nodes.title: Genocchi numbers from their generating function

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the rational number $2(1 - 2^n) B_n$, where $B_n$ is the $n$-th Bernoulli number with the convention $B_1 = -\tfrac{1}{2}$, equals the Genocchi number $G_n$ defined by the exponential generating function $\frac{2x}{e^x + 1} = \sum_{m \ge 0} G_m \frac{x^m}{m!}$.
nodes.title: The two definitions of the Genocchi numbers agree

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, the Genocchi number $G_n \in \mathbb{Q}$ is $n!$ times the coefficient of $x^n$ in the Genocchi power series $\frac{2x}{e^x + 1} \in \mathbb{Q}[[x]]$, so that $\frac{2x}{e^x + 1} = \sum_{n \ge 0} G_n \frac{x^n}{n!}$.
nodes.title: Genocchi numbers

nodes.summary: The Genocchi power series equals $2x \cdot (e^x + 1)^{-1}$ in $\mathbb{Q}[[x]]$, where $e^x = \sum_{n \ge 0} x^n / n!$ is the exponential power series and $(e^x + 1)^{-1}$ is the inverse of $e^x + 1$ among formal power series.
nodes.title: The Genocchi power series is $2x/(e^x + 1)$

nodes.summary: The Genocchi power series is the formal power series $\frac{2x}{e^x + 1} = 2x \cdot (e^x + 1)^{-1}$ in $\mathbb{Q}[[x]]$, where $e^x = \sum_{n \ge 0} x^n / n!$ is the exponential power series and $(e^x + 1)^{-1}$ is the inverse of $e^x + 1$ among formal power series. It is the exponential generating function of the Genocchi numbers $G_n$, that is, $\frac{2x}{e^x + 1} = \sum_{n \ge 0} G_n \frac{x^n}{n!}$.
nodes.title: Generating function of the Genocchi numbers

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
